title: Isobavachin Ameliorates Acetaminophen-Induced Liver Injury Through Modulation of CYP2E1-Mediated Bioactivation and NRF2/PI3K/AKT Cytoprotective Pathways.
authors: Ye, Wenjie; Zhang, Shuaishuai; Zhou, Youxi; Li, Mengting; Guo, Zitao; Xu, Yuexin; Wu, Zhenkun; Liu, Xinyi; Huang, Xuhong; Pang, Jianxin; Wu, Ting
journal: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究异黄酮化合物对乙酰氨基酚肝损伤的保护机制，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acetaminophen (APAP)-induced liver injury (AILI) remains a critical clinical challenge with limited therapeutic options. This research elucidates the mechanisms through which the natural flavonoid isobavachin (ISO) confers protection against APAP-induced liver injury. In vivo experiments demonstrated that ISO treatment significantly attenuated histopathological parameters, oxidative stress and inflammation, as indicated by serum ALT/AST, MDA, SOD/GSH, TNF-alpha/IL-1beta levels. Mechanistically, ISO inhibited CYP2E1 expression and promoted NRF2 activation. Furthermore, integrated network pharmacology, transcriptomics, and molecular docking simulations revealed the PI3K/AKT signaling pathway as a potential targets of ISO, demonstrating high-affinity confirmed between ISO and PI3K (-8.6 kcal/mol) or AKT (-6.4 kcal/mol) respectively. western blotting assay confirmed that ISO activated PI3K/AKT signaling and upregulated downstream anti-apoptotic- protein BCL2. These findings collectively suggest that ISO alleviates AILI through multi-mechanisms: inhibiting CYP2E1-mediated APAP bioactivation, modulating of the NRF2/PI3K/AKT signaling, ISO attenuates oxidative damage, suppresses inflammatory activation, and inhibits apoptosis. The results suggest that ISO represents a potential therapeutic agent for managing APAP-induced hepatotoxicity.
abstract_zh: 对乙酰氨基酚（APAP）诱导的肝损伤（AILI）仍是临床上的重大挑战，治疗选择有限。本研究阐明了天然黄酮类化合物异补骨脂查尔酮（ISO）对APAP诱导肝损伤的保护机制。体内实验表明，ISO处理显著改善了组织病理学参数、氧化应激和炎症，这通过血清ALT/AST、MDA、SOD/GSH、TNF-α/IL-1β水平得以体现。机制上，ISO抑制了CYP2E1表达并促进NRF2激活。此外，整合网络药理学、转录组学和分子对接模拟揭示PI3K/AKT信号通路为ISO的潜在靶点，并证实ISO与PI3K（-8.6 kcal/mol）或AKT（-6.4 kcal/mol）之间具有高亲和力。Western blotting实验确认ISO激活了PI3K/AKT信号通路，并上调下游抗凋亡蛋白BCL2。这些发现共同表明，ISO通过多种机制缓解AILI：抑制CYP2E1介导的APAP生物活化，调节NRF2/PI3K/AKT信号通路，减轻氧化损伤、抑制炎症激活和细胞凋亡。结果表明，ISO是治疗APAP诱导肝毒性的潜在治疗药物。
